summary: Restore native diagnostics safety and Python parity

delivery.outcome: Repair reproduced native scanner and snapshot audit/listing refusal and parity regressions, preserve verified Python fallback and publish via protected independent validation. Avoid synchronous cold compilation during read-only diagnostics.
nonGoals: No user IDE signals, restarts or session database repairs
No protected CI/profile/policy changes or dependency additions

architecture.decision: Retain worker acceleration for supported validated inputs; use anchored no-follow nonblocking reads, strict bounded JSON parsing and store identity checks. Unsupported encodings or encrypted listing use the existing Python fallback. Compilation remains explicit via existing build-native CLI.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of this bounded remediation; retain previous installed CLI release.

validation.evidence: Ancestor symlink rejection in direct worker and wrapper; nonblocking bounded file reads.
Forced Python/native panic parity for multiline, repeated prefixes and supported ASCII; Unicode uses Python.
Malformed JSON/date/checksum/symlink refusal and deterministic snapshot health parity.
Store origin/schema/encryption identity and encrypted fallback; cold queries never invoke rustc.
Full mandatory X11 and product/governance checks; exact-head protected publication.
